title: Croatian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Croatia, adapted to a Chinese twist.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the stew for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the beef broth, browned beef, and peas. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
